item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 05/Jan/2026
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The winter monsoon will affect the coast of Guangdong gradually later today, the weather will become cold over the region in the following couple of days. It will be fine and very dry with rather large temperature difference between day and night. With the monsoon moderating slightly, temperatures will rise slightly over southern China during the weekend to early next week, the weather will be persistently fine, but it will still be cool in the morning.

Date/Month: 05/01 (Monday)
Wind: Northeast force 3, becoming north force 4 to 5.
Weather: Mainly fine. Cloudy periods at first. Dry during the day.
Temp range: 15 - 22 C
R.H. range: 40 - 80 per Cent
PSR: Low
